subject: PayNova telemetry & stress-test synchronization
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Aldo Vargas <aldo@paynova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: telemetry fields + stress test window (PayNova)

Hi Aldo / Sofia —

Thanks for the sync today. Per our conversation, we want to align on the telemetry schema and the concrete load window for the initial stress run so we can validate latency/throughput SLOs and produce an acceptance artifact you can share internally.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the peak traffic shape (qps and typical request size) for the 30-minute stress window.
- We share the Redwood telemetry schema and a lightweight Excel plan for the run.
- After the run, you upload the raw CSV and we’ll produce the latency P95/P99 readout and a short evidence summary.

Attached: paynova-stressplan-v1.xlsx (starter plan) and our telemetry schema doc.

Questions: is there a preferred maintenance window this week (Thu/Fri) for a 30-min run? We can do Thu 16:00-17:00 PT if that works on your side.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
[Attachment: paynova-stressplan-v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: redwood-telemetry-schema.md (md)]

From: Aldo Vargas <aldo@paynova.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Marin <sofia@paynova.com>, cloudops@paynova.com
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: telemetry fields + stress test window (PayNova)

Hi Ava —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick answers:
- Peak shape: 1.8k RPS sustained with 2.5k RPS spikes for ~2 minutes. Payload average ~1.2KB.
- Maintenance window: Thursday 16:00 PT works. CloudOps will open temporary increased concurrency for the window.

We'll run the script and upload the CSV to the Drive folder you shared. One ask: can Redwood include a matching request-id and timestamp format so we can join traces back to our logs?

I’ll loop in our CloudOps alias for coordination.

—Aldo
Aldo Vargas
Director of Engineering, PayNova
aldo@paynova.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aldo Vargas <aldo@paynova.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: telemetry fields + stress test window (PayNova)

Aldo — thanks for the numbers. We’ll tailor the run plan to 1.8k steady / 2.5k spikes and include both short-burst and steady-state segments in the workbook.

On telemetry: we’ll emit a header called "x-redwood-request-id" and include an ISO8601 timestamp (ms precision) in the payload so you can join. The attached telemetry schema doc shows the exact fields and a sample line.

Plan for Thursday 16:00 PT (window):
- 15:45: Redwood health-check and baseline quick-check (no load).
- 16:00–16:10: ramp to 1.8k RPS.
- 16:10–16:20: steady at 1.8k.
- 16:20–16:22: spike to 2.5k for 2 minutes.
- 16:22–16:45: run mixed traffic (latency-sensitive + batch requests).
- 16:45–16:55: cooldown and artifact collection.

Attachment: updated run plan (we incremented the CSV column that maps to request-size buckets).

We will also stream a short status channel to your CloudOps alias and drop artifacts to the Drive folder.

Monica Patel
Onboarding & Performance Lead | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
[Attachment: paynova-stressplan-v1.xlsx (updated)]

From: Aldo Vargas <aldo@paynova.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Marin <sofia@paynova.com>, cloudops@paynova.com
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: telemetry fields + stress test window (PayNova)

Team —

We executed the run on Thu as planned and uploaded the raw CSV (run-20280308-results.csv) to the Drive folder. Highlights:
- Steady 1.8k RPS segment: P50 45ms, P95 210ms, P99 490ms.
- 2 min spike to 2.5k: brief tail increase, P99 peaked at 1.2s for a 90s window.
- No errors, <0.02% 5xx.

Uploading artifact: run-20280308-results.csv (attached in Drive). Can Redwood produce the P95/P99 chart and the short evidence summary for our internal acceptance gate? If possible we’d like the chart + short blurb by EOD today.

—Aldo
[Attachment: run-20280308-results.csv (csv)]

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Aldo Vargas <aldo@paynova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: telemetry fields + stress test window (PayNova)

Aldo — great results, thanks for running that and for the artifact. Monica and Karthik have a quick analysis below; we’ll deliver a one-page acceptance summary and the P95/P99 chart in the Drive folder by 18:00 PT.

Preliminary notes from Redwood:
- Baseline: steady-state numbers are within the expected performance envelope for your policy tier.
- Spike behavior: tail latency rise is expected with the short 2-minute overshoot — we recommend the following mitigations if you want tighter tail: enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts and consider moving the most latency-sensitive routes to a pinned instance pool for the first 48 hours of high load.

Action items:
- Redwood to upload acceptance_summary_paynova_20280309.pdf + p95_p99_chart.png to Drive (Ava / Monica) — ETA 18:00 PT.
- PayNova to review and confirm acceptance for their internal gate by Mon 12:00 PT.
- If accepted, schedule hard cutover and set autoretry window per the runbook.

Thanks — will follow up in the Drive share and HubSpot deal notes (PN-4721).

Best,
Ava Chen
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
